board_fields.planned_use_cm: optional number; computed from cuts when omitted
board_fields.planned_waste_cm: optional number; computed from stock_length_cm - planned_use_cm when omitted

summary_optional_fields.safety_margin_cm: field margin subtracted from each measured board, e.g. 5
summary_optional_fields.kerf_margin_cm: legacy alias used as safety_margin_cm if safety_margin_cm is missing
